authorization: User/planner explicitly authorized the DEV80 overnight stage after the completed EPP321 Pilot16 refinement.
scientific_question: On all 80 frozen development images, does compute-matched NP_EPP_321 improve recovery beyond four independent NP-1 trajectories, and is the resulting NP method competitive with freshly rerun DAPS and pinned SITCOM baselines on the same locked measurements?

measurement_policy.pilot16: Reuse exactly the already-materialized locked development measurement for each Pilot16 image.
measurement_policy.remaining64: Materialize exactly one measurement using the already-frozen dev_measurement_seed in B24_METHOD_IMAGE_ROLES.csv.

DAPS4.implementation: Pinned B24 external DAPS implementation and frozen DAPS-1 semantics; four independent native solver seeds on each development measurement.
DAPS4.best_of_four_role: GT-selected external candidate-set oracle ceiling only

SITCOM4.implementation: Pinned public SITCOM-ODE implementation and the exact B24 runtime configuration used by the baseline screen; four independent native solver seeds on each development measurement.
SITCOM4.best_of_four_role: GT-selected external candidate-set oracle ceiling only

NP4_INDEPENDENT.source: Reuse completed Pilot16 result for 16 images; execute prospectively on the remaining 64.

NP_EPP_321.source: Reuse completed EPP321 refinement result for 16 images; execute unchanged on the remaining 64.

NP_EPP_321_RANDOM_PRUNE.source: Reuse completed EPP321 refinement result for 16 images; execute unchanged on the remaining 64.

NP_EPP_321_NO_REALLOCATION.source: Reuse completed EPP321 refinement result for 16 images; execute unchanged on the remaining 64.

evaluation_policy.fresh_baseline_classification: Recompute A/B/C/D independently on each development measurement using fresh DAPS-4 and SITCOM-4 GT-best candidate PSNR; preserve original class only as the screening stratum.

compute_policy.within_np_family: UNet forward evaluations are the dominant fixed-work proxy because model, resolution, scheduler and measurement operator are identical.
compute_policy.np4_vs_epp321: exactly matched at 8800 total UNet evaluations per image
compute_policy.cross_family: Do not equate NP UNet evaluations with DAPS/SITCOM iterations. Preserve native protocol parameters and measured GPU/wall diagnostics now; final fixed/similar-compute claims require method-specific FLOPs or a defensible forward/operator-equivalent accounting.

resource_contract.worker_failure_policy: Fail the affected image but continue later assigned development images; final DEV80 gate remains closed until every image has a PASS completion.
